# The maps of the module pages, generated by org.hortonmachine.docs.ModuleMapsGenerator
# (see docs/manual/README.md) on the sample data of the data folder.
#
# Module | example script | raster to draw | colortable | options | class names
#
# The scripts run in this order, each on the outputs of the previous ones. The image is
# Module_raster.png: a module with several outputs has one line each, with the script
# only in the first one and - in the others.
# The raster can be the difference of two rasters: a.tif - b.tif, or a vector of lines (.shp),
# drawn in the strongest color of the colortable.
# The raster can be - for a module without a map: its script is only run.
# The colortable is one of the HortonMachine ones (EColorTables), rainbow if it is not.
# Options: positive (draw only values above 0), classes (legend with the distinct values
# of the raster, at most 30, not a bar: for integer classes and codes),
# nolegend (no legend, for example for a single class), clip (colors from the 2nd to the
# 98th percentile, for rasters with a few extreme values)
# The class names, as 1=stable;2=unstable, replace the values in the legend of the classes.
